band_change_evidence_test.explanation: The two-source requirement passes: The Robot Report and Plastics News are independent publications, and the 2018 closure and the 2024 relaunch are separately corroborated. The tier requirement does not pass. The corporate-status finding rests on trade reporting at tier 3; no insolvency filing, court record or company statement was obtained directly, so United Robotics Group’s bankruptcy is established only through secondary reporting. The result is recorded as PARTIAL. In this case the tier shortfall matters less than usual, because the finding at issue is a verifiable factual question about corporate status rather than a judgment about practice, and it is separately corroborated across two publications and across a seven-year span. A coordinator should confirm the corporate status against a primary filing before any delisting decision.

key_evidence: Why it matters: Rethink Robotics is not an operating company. The benchmark publishes it at rank 27 with the band "Established", which is the second-highest label the benchmark issues.

The Robot Report reported on 16 September 2025 that Rethink Robotics had shut down for the second time. United Robotics Group’s investors withdrew funding, the parent filed for bankruptcy, and Rethink Robotics was discontinued in the United States.
The original Rethink Robotics closed in 2018 and HAHN Group bought its technology. United Robotics Group relaunched the brand in September 2024. The relaunch lasted twelve months.
The former chief executive said the products "weren’t ready to be released, so sales was behind plan", and described letting go of a newly hired team as "heartbreaking".
A customer asked publicly, "I have a new arm from Rethink robotics, what can I do?" No answer is recorded. The fate of the company’s intellectual property and latest models had not been announced.

notes: FLAG FOR REVIEW — PRIMARY ISSUE IS ENTITY-RECORD CURRENCY, NOT SCORE. Rethink Robotics ceased operations for the second time in September 2025 after United Robotics Group’s investors withdrew funding and the parent filed for bankruptcy. It is not an operating company. The index carries it at rank 27 with band "Established", which is the benchmark’s second-highest label applied to a dissolved entity. THE RECOMMENDED REMEDY IS DELISTING OR A SUCCESSOR RECORD WITH ACCURATE STATUS, not the application of a score. The 13.1 composite is included because the methodology has no not-applicable state and a carried entity must be scorable; it states that no compassion infrastructure exists, and it should not be read as a conduct judgment on a company that ran out of money. This is the sixth open entity-currency case in the backlog alongside Hercules Offshore (dissolved 2016).
